content.title: Colors Magic Expanded
about: Expanded version of ColorsMagic to explore additional content and mechanics.
Academic team project with focus on iteration, integration, and user experience.
Contributed to gameplay improvements and project stability.
learnings: Mobile-first input & UI constraints (touch targets, readability, aspect ratios).
Iterating quickly with Git branching, code reviews, and frequent integration.
Balancing performance and visuals for mobile builds (profiling, lightweight effects).
